{{Quote|It's not in my nature not to trust.|Bronk worries about his trusting nature leading to his arrest|<ref name="Inc" />}}
'''Dewell Bronk''' was [[Kedorzhan]] who served as a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Bronk was best known for his desire to help others, a fact that the Republic's successor state, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], eventually used when attempting to track him down. Toward the end of the war, Bronk was one of many senators who, as part of the [[Delegation of 2000]], signed the [[Petition of 2000]], a document condemning the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] misuse of emergency powers and the formation of the new office of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]].

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], after the Clone Wars had ended, Bronk attempted to flee the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in an attempt to escape the persecution that many members of the delegation were facing from the [[Declaration of a New Order|newly formed]] Galactic Empire. During his journey off-planet he encountered the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who was also fleeing with the [[Youngling/Legends|young]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|infant]]. Bronk did not recognize Kenobi, though the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] saved Bronk from a pair of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] who attempted to arrest the Kedorzhan. Kenobi then revealed the reality of life in [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] to the senator, persuading him to try and return to Coruscant and falsely announce his support for the new Empire. This would better enable the senator to help others without fear of persecution.

==Biography==
===The kindly senator===
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Inc" /> a conflict fought between [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Dewell Bronk served as a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], the ruling body of the Republic. Within the Senate, Bronk represented his [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Kedorzhan]]s,<ref name="Inc" /> who hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kedorzha]] in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> While working as a senator, Bronk lived on the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where he owned an apartment and was protected by several [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]]. Due to his helpful nature, Bronk was a three time recipient of the [[Good Neighbor of the Year award]], an award that was given by the [[Coruscant Benevolent Society]].<ref name="Inc" />

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Clone Wars, Bronk had seven children, but lost one&mdash;during the conflict, Dewell's child [[Tyloor]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in action while fighting for the Republic, and his body was not recovered from the battlefield where he fell. The loss of his child, along with several other factors, led Senator Bronk to join a faction known as the [[Delegation of 2000]]. The Delegation's members all signed the [[Petition of 2000]], a document stating their dissatisfaction with the actions of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the war,<ref name="Inc" /> particularly the formation of the office of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]]. They presented the document to the Chancellor shortly before the end of the war in 19 BBY.<ref name="D2000">{{InsiderCite|85|Who's Who in the Delegation of 2000}}</ref>

===On the run===
After the end of the Clone Wars and the [[Declaration of a New Order|declaration]] of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the political system of the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], many members of the Delegation of 2000 were arrested&mdash;some members, including Senator [[Nee Alavar/Legends|Nee Alavar]] of the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]], were even executed.<ref name="D2000" /> In fear of persecution, many of the remaining members withdrew their signatures from the petition, but Bronk refused to do so and instead fled from Coruscant for his own safety. Leaving his bodyguards behind, the Kedorzhan boarded a ''[[Tallaan Clipper]]'' [[Starship/Legends|transport]] named the ''[[Space Slug]]'' which was headed off-world. While on board, he tried to remain inconspicuous, but was horrified to see a pair of [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]] harassing and robbing an elderly [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Unidentified elderly Twi'lek female|woman]].<ref name="Inc" />

Bronk attempted to tell the thugs to stop, but was too fearful for his own safety to succeed. Giving up hope, he was surprised to hear another passenger, a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] with an infant [[Youngling/Legends|child]], warn the Devaronians to leave the woman alone. Bronk expected that the man would be beaten, but was shocked to see the Devaronians leaving the woman, who then fled. Bronk then gave advice on looking after the infant to the young man, who unbeknownst to the senator was in fact [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] fleeing Coruscant himself with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]],<ref name="Inc" /> the newly-[[Reproduction/Legends|born]] son of Bronk's fellow senator and delegation member [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}, ''Seeds of Rebellion'' deleted scene</ref> Bronk informed Kenobi that the baby was hungry when it started crying, a possibility that had escaped the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="Inc" />

===A change of plans===
{{Quote|Dewell Bronk?''"<br />"''That is my name.''"<br />"''Senator Bronk, you are under arrest.''"<br />"''On whose authority?''"<br />"''Emperor Palpatine.|A pair of clone troopers arrest Dewell Bronk|<ref name="Inc" />}}
[[File:Kenobi_saves_Bronk.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Kenobi incapacitated two clone troopers to prevent them from arresting Bronk.]]
Once the transport arrived at its [[Unidentified green-skied planet|destination]], the pair were required to disembark and transfer to a new ship in order to reach the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. While trying to reach [[Pad 560]], where his next transport was located, Bronk ran into a [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] [[Unidentified Ortolan janitor|janitor]] being physically harassed by a pair of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. The Kedorzhan stepped forward and struck one of the [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] with a bag of his possessions, telling them to leave the janitor alone. The troopers allowed the Ortolan to flee but recognized the senator, as they were searching the planet for him specifically, and the two attempted to arrest him. Bronk did not resist, but as he prepared to be taken away, the troopers were attacked from behind and incapacitated by Kenobi, who used the janitor's equipment to temporarily blind them and then push them into a maintenance area.<ref name="Inc" />

The senator thanked the stranger and lamented that he would have to live the rest of his life fearing such occurrences, and Kenobi pointed out that the troopers had been using Bronk's known desire to help others as a way to find him by harassing the Ortolan. The Jedi also confessed that he suspected that the Devaronians on the ''Space Slug'' had been informants trying to draw Bronk out as well. Kenobi then pointed out that the senator had options other than a life on the run, and Bronk realized that his best option was to return to Coruscant and feign support of the Empire so that he could continue his work in the Senate. He and Kenobi then parted ways, with the Jedi leaving for the Outer Rim and Bronk heading back the way he came.<ref name="Inc" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Strength! I'm afraid of every bright light and loud noise.|Bronk admits his fear to Kenobi|<ref name="Inc" />}}
Bronk was a Kedorzhan with black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]] who stood one [[Meter/Legends|meter]] tall and had a relatively pudgy stature. He also had a broad [[Nose/Legends|nose]], which he twitched when disdainful of something. As a Kedorzhan, the senator was almost blind in brightly-lit environments, seeing others as little more than blurry shapes, but he refused to wear a visor to protect his eyes, as he believed in looking others in the eye when speaking to them. He was well known for his loud authoritative voice and, like his predecessors, Bronk had a tendency to fight for those who could not defend themselves.<ref name="Inc" />

His desire to help others was what led him to win the Good Neighbor of the Year award multiple times, as well as signing the Petition of 2000. Bronk felt that many of Palpatine's actions in no way aided the war and arbitrarily removed aid for the weak, something that the Kedorzhan opposed. The death of his son also contributed to Bronk's signing of the Petition, which he did despite the protests of his advisers.<ref name="Inc" />

His small size caused him to fear few would listen to him outside of the Senate, and fear for his own safety prevented Bronk from helping others in need after he fled from Coruscant, although he overcame the fear when he saw [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] troopers attacking an innocent Ortolan. Bronk's helpful and trusting nature defined him so much that the Empire used it to try and capture him, setting up situations where he would show himself while trying to aid others. The Kedorzhan was able to aid Kenobi as he looked after the infant Luke Skywalker as he had experience in parenting from raising his own children, although Bronk wished he had spent more time with his offspring and was unaware of where all bar Tyloor were at the time of his escape.<ref name="Inc" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dewell Bronk first appeared in "[[Incognito]]," a short story by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[John Jackson Miller]] and illustrated by [[Chris Scalf]], which was published in ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' [[Star Wars Insider 143|143]]<ref name="Inc" /> on [[July 23]], [[2013]].<ref name="InsiderDate">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/143|text=''Star Wars Insider'' 143}}</ref>
